goals: Implement a transactional 1:1 counseling booking engine with SQLite persistence.
Ensure strict session pass management with idempotency and conservation invariants.
Enable atomic booking, rescheduling, and cancellation with waitlist auto-promotion.
Provide system-wide reconciliation and audit logging for integrity verification.
user_flows: Counselor registers and adds available slots.
Client tops up session pass using an idempotency key.
Client books an available slot (deducts session).
Client reschedules a booking to a new available slot (atomic swap).
Client joins a waitlist for a booked slot.
Client cancels a booking, triggering automatic promotion of the first eligible waitlisted client.

states.transitions: AVAILABLE -> BOOKED, AVAILABLE -> BLOCKED, BOOKED -> AVAILABLE, BLOCKED -> AVAILABLE

business_rules: Slot status must be AVAILABLE to be BOOKED or BLOCKED.
Session pass remaining_sessions must never be < 0.
Waitlist promotion requires remaining_sessions >= 1 at time of promotion.
Rescheduling must be atomic: old slot released and new slot occupied in one transaction.
Idempotency keys in pass_ledger and bookings must prevent duplicate state changes.
edge_cases: Rescheduling to a slot that becomes BOOKED by another client simultaneously.
Cancelling a booking where no waitlisted clients have sufficient session passes.
Issuing a session pass with a duplicate idempotency key.
Attempting to block a slot that is already BOOKED.
design_decisions: Use SQLite transactions (BEGIN/COMMIT) to ensure atomicity of the Booking Saga.
Implement a FIFO queue for the waitlist using an auto-incrementing primary key or timestamp.
Use ISO 8601 strings for date-time to ensure SQLite compatibility and sorting.
Enforce data integrity via SQLite FOREIGN KEY constraints.
assumptions: The system runs in a single-process environment or handles SQLite locking appropriately.
Client email is a unique identifier for session passes.

methods.register_counselor(counselor_id: str, na: Raises ValueError on duplicate ID or empty fields.
methods.add_slot(counselor_id: str, start_time:: Returns slot details. Raises ValueError on duplicate slot.
methods.block_slot(counselor_id: str, start_time: Transitions AVAILABLE to BLOCKED. Raises ValueError otherwise.
methods.issue_session_pass(client_email: str, se: Updates pass and ledger. Handles idempotency.
methods.reschedule_booking(booking_id: str, clie: Atomic slot swap. No session change.
methods.join_waitlist(counselor_id: str, start_t: Adds to FIFO waitlist if slot is BOOKED.
methods.get_system_reconciliation() -> dict: Returns integrity summary and is_balanced boolean.

ddl: CREATE TABLE counselors (counselor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, specialty TEXT)
CREATE TABLE slots (slot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, counselor_id TEXT, start_time TEXT, status TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(counselor_id) REFERENCES counselors(counselor_id))
CREATE TABLE session_passes (client_email TEXT PRIMARY KEY, remaining_sessions INTEGER, used_sessions INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE pass_ledger (entry_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, client_email TEXT, booking_id TEXT, entry_type TEXT, delta_sessions INTEGER, idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE)
CREATE TABLE bookings (booking_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, counselor_id TEXT, start_time TEXT, client_name TEXT, client_email TEXT, status TEXT, idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE)
CREATE TABLE waitlist (waitlist_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, counselor_id TEXT, start_time TEXT, client_name TEXT, client_email TEXT, status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (log_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, booking_id TEXT, event_type TEXT, from_status TEXT, to_status TEXT, timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
